reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage exactly maps the six supplied capability needs to direct coverage and leaves the two non-capability needs with missing-safe unsupported sentinels, preserving record identifiers.

prioritize_needs contradicts its declared behavior: records with direct coverage are marked unsupported=true and ranked before the actually unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07. This reverses the required unsupported-before-covered ordering and makes the selected top priority n06-r02 instead of the highest-ranked unsupported need.

synthesize_recommendation appears to retain the eight priority rows and derive the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record, but that input ordering was already corrupted by prioritize_needs, so the final recommendation inherits the upstream fault rather than localizing a new defect here.
